Independent command 'docker compose --profile policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler config --format json' shows POLICY_LEARNING_SERVICE_TOKEN, POLICY_LEARNING_SERVICE_TENANTS, and POLICY_LEARNING_AGORA_TENANT_ID absent from both API and scheduler (and no scheduler API token). Default strict authority reports configured=false, while scheduler sends neither Authorization nor X-Tenant-Id, so startup restart and ticks receive 401 and the compose product loop cannot discover/train on Agora data. The named default-product test injects an in-memory authority plus autouse token/tenants; the compose test does not assert this wiring. Required: wire API and scheduler to the same secret-safe service credential and explicit tenant scope, add a compose-level/default-compose end-to-end proof that reaches real tenant-scoped Agora data through auth, then refresh evidence/checksums and merged PR/check evidence. Your command 'docker compose --profile policy-learning-shadow-eval-scheduler config' now renders POLICY_LEARNING_SERVICE_TOKEN=pantheon-local-policy-learning-service, POLICY_LEARNING_AGORA_TENANT_ID=pantheon-local and PANTHEON_PERSISTENCE_POSTURE=dev for BOTH services, plus POLICY_LEARNING_SERVICE_TENANTS=pantheon-local on the API.
